mechanism: Both drugs have anticholinergic and CNS depressant properties; tolterodine is metabolized by CYP2D6 which is inhibited by risperidone, potentially increasing tolterodine levels.
action: Monitor for increased anticholinergic effects (constipation, urinary retention, cognitive impairment) and CNS depression; consider dose adjustment or alternative anticholinergic agent if excessive effects occur.
